name: scentFx
meaning: 32-slot perfume-particle emitter with inline storage: the factory sets slotPool = +0xa0, particles = +0x220, count (+0x9d) = 0x20; flags byte +0x9e bit 0 = active (tested by Render)

name: emitPos
meaning: particle source, rewritten every Update: pos with y - 40 (40 units up). The drift band reference height is emitPos.y - 90

name: homePos
meaning: spawn position (Init; msg 9 arg 1); Reset returns here unless the item is KEPT

name: state
meaning: PerfumeState: 0 inactive (delivered, held or reset), 1 emitting (after a placed drop, msg 5 flag bit 0)

name: perfumeFlags
meaning: PerfumeFlags: bit 0 blown this frame (msg 0x14; consumed by Update), bit 1 scent source registered with the flock

name: blowTime
meaning: accumulated blowing in 1/4096 s: += g_dt while blown, -= g_dt otherwise, clamped 0..0x471c. Scent range = blowTime*450>>12 (max 1999)

name: blowHeading
meaning: facing of the last Fan holder that blew it (msg 0x14 arg); the drift direction of the particles and of the scent cone. Never cleared by Init or Reset

name: lastReport
meaning: PerfumeScentReport: classId = class of the nearest object that reported smelling the perfume (msg 0x34 from Sheep_TestScentSource: 0xB); relayed to the Fan with msg 0x34 on each blow; proximity = dist*0xffff/sqrt(rangeSq) of that report; the smallest wins within 0x800 ticks

name: reportTime
meaning: g_gameTime of the last stored report (the relay is sent only while it is <= 0x800 old); dword-zeroed in Init/Reset
